lines.context: 仿制黏团的完整使用说明，四个英文折行合为一个逻辑句
lines.text: Combine this blob in an anvil with any item which is a skinned skull to turn it into a decoration block which you can place on your island.
lines.raw: §7Combine this blob in an anvil with any item which is a §dskinned skull §7to turn it into a decoration block which you can place on your island.
lines.zh: 在铁砧中将此黏团与任意带皮肤的头颅物品合并,将其变为可放置在私人岛屿上的装饰方块。
